name: helioterm
description: Deterministic terminal compression with an adaptive Desktop-native Luna semantic channel.

interface.shortDescription: Rule-first terminal compression with adaptive Luna.
interface.longDescription: HelioTerm batches bounded tests, builds, quality checks, read-only Git, search, source/config inspection, dependency, version, benchmark, and process observations into one deterministic local call. Large material failures or changes can route bounded evidence to one reusable Desktop-native Luna task; code validates the note and the task is archived after the burst.
defaultPrompt: Use $helioterm for bounded tests, checks, Git, search, source/config inspection, dependency, version, benchmark, and process observations; batch up to four compatible operations.
